slots.role: Statement about the wider context; its key word made visual
slots.visualRecipe: Light ground, one centred line of 2-3 words at about 0.05 frame-height caps; then the dark ground with the key word in the accent at about 0.58 frame width; two full-frame photographs of crowds under that word, the word white; back to the accent word on dark.
slots.motionRecipe: Line words every 2 frames with a 3-4 frame rise; hard cut; key word typed one letter per 2 frames, scaling up about 15%; hard cuts to photo 1 on the frame the word completes, photo 2 after 10 frames, accent word on dark after 10, next slot after 7. The word never moves.
slots.soundRecipe: Silent first 0.5 s; a low intro under the line; a transient on the cut into the typing (inferred).

copySlot.purpose: Opening clause naming a broad fact, with one key word

slots.role: Turn the statement to the viewer
slots.visualRecipe: Light ground, centred line; four rounded photo cards of people (0.10-0.13 frame width) in the four corners.
slots.motionRecipe: First word lands about 1.3x then settles as the next word joins; cards fly in from the edges in about 6 frames, brake, drift outward slowly; text replacement on the held layout after about 1 s.
slots.soundRecipe: Low intro continues; transients near the text replacement (inferred).

copySlot.purpose: The viewer's own situation, completing the opening statement

slots.visualRecipe: Dark ground, one frame empty; a pale disc at centre about 13% frame width; the mark inside it; the wordmark at about 0.5 frame width with a small sub-line; accent colour first, white at the end.
slots.motionRecipe: Dot grows 6 frames (power3.out); mark wipes in 12 frames, holds 6; disc travels right about 0.2 frame width over 7 frames revealing letters behind it; disc resolves into the final punctuation over 10 frames; sub-line fades in 3 frames; colour flip on one frame 17 frames later.
slots.soundRecipe: Transients through the build (measured onsets during it); the track still in its intro (inferred).

copySlot.purpose: Brand name and a two-word category

slots.role: The promise in one line, then made felt
slots.visualRecipe: Light ground, centred line; then three full-width rows of the promise's last words with outlined icon chips, repeats in mid grey, bleeding off both edges.
slots.motionRecipe: Words every 2 frames; hard cut to the rows already moving rightwards and braking to a near hold in about 25 frames (expo.out), held about 0.5 s.
slots.soundRecipe: A transient on the cut to the rows (measured on the source film); intro ending (inferred).

copySlot.purpose: What the product lets you do, ending on the plural thing it handles

slots.visualRecipe: The product's real main screen cropped about 1.4x, then its summary page arriving out of near-white with a soft warm bloom top right; a summarising line at the bottom.
slots.motionRecipe: Slow push on the first crop with a cursor drift; the second page fades up from white in about 4 frames; words every 2 frames.
slots.soundRecipe: The music lifts here: full energy from this slot on (inferred from loudness).

copySlot.purpose: One-line summary that it is all together

slots.role: First capability, as a moving symbol
slots.visualRecipe: Dark ground; a pastel disc carrying a symbol on a thick accent trail, text on the opposite side; mirrored on the next cut; then one small centred line with an inline icon chip.
slots.motionRecipe: Disc lands on its trail in 5 frames then drifts; the symbol swaps once per shot after about 17 frames; layout mirrors on the hard cut; inline chip pops in 1-2 frames after the first words.
slots.soundRecipe: Full-energy music; transients near the cuts but not locked (measured on the source film).

copySlot.purpose: Capability verb and object, then its breadth, then its reach

slots.visualRecipe: Light ground; four cut-out portraits on tinted rounded plates (about 0.25 frame height) with small round badges converge around a centred line; then a plain line.
slots.motionRecipe: Plates converge from the corners in about 5 frames and drift; hard cut; words every 2 frames.
slots.soundRecipe: Brief dip in level (inferred from loudness).

copySlot.purpose: Who benefits and the easier outcome

slots.role: Proof: the real flow, cut on clicks
slots.visualRecipe: The product's real screens, windows at 85-95% width on the dark ground or full-frame; two-line caption bottom left on the first page; yellow cursor about 2.5% of frame height.
slots.motionRecipe: Caption words rise in; cut to about 1.6x on the button with the caption held; then four steps, each ended by a press and a hard cut, the next window rising about 3% over 5-6 frames; fast 6-frame scrolls inside steps; final push-in on the result.
slots.soundRecipe: Cuts do not follow the music here (measured at chance on the source film); a click sound per press may be added (inferred).

copySlot.purpose: Caption naming the action in 3 words

slots.visualRecipe: Dark ground; a short line split around a photograph of an end user with a small purchase card overlaid; then a light ground with a line and its replacement.
slots.motionRecipe: Card snap-zooms from about 0.32 to 0.6 frame width in 3 frames, cursor presses; hard cut to light; words every 2 frames; hard text replacement.
slots.soundRecipe: Level dips at the start of this slot (inferred from loudness).

copySlot.purpose: Integration claim, then what it collects

slots.visualRecipe: Dark ground, the verb in the accent split in two staggered halves with a product card inserted in the gap; light ground with the verb whole in dark ink; dark ground with a small word, an outlined arrow pill with two icon chips, the object word in the accent; dark ground with a white word over a giant blurred counter.
slots.motionRecipe: Card flies up tilted and settles flat in 5 frames; one empty light frame; verb opens a gap in 5 frames (power2.in) and the cut lands on the open gap; pill widens, right chip swaps every 10-16 frames; one empty dark frame; counter steps on frames 0, 2, 4, 7, 11 to zero and holds 13.
slots.soundRecipe: Cut on transients where the track has them (two cuts in this slot sat exactly on onsets in the source film).

copySlot.purpose: Verb with its two ends, and the speed claim

slots.visualRecipe: The product's real screen on white, built top-down; then a wider view snapped about 1.5x and shifted left with a two-line caption on the right.
slots.motionRecipe: Elements appear in reading order; a figure types digit by digit; 4-frame snap reframe; caption words rise; a soft accent highlight sweeps left to right over the key rows over 6 frames.

copySlot.purpose: Caption naming a second benefit in 3 words

slots.visualRecipe: Light ground, one centred line per shot, the third line one size larger.
slots.motionRecipe: Line 1 drifts up accelerating for 10 frames; line 2 rises from below with words every 2 frames; hard replacement by line 3.
slots.soundRecipe: Swaps on loudness swells where the track has them (inferred).

copySlot.purpose: Effort saved, then the gain it frees up

slots.visualRecipe: Dark ground; one huge white word (about 0.6 frame width) over an accent-to-dark gradient area chart with a riding dot and a small counter; then the word small on light ground as the line completes.
slots.motionRecipe: Counter climbs over 24 frames (power3.out), dot rides the curve; hard cut to light; remaining words every 2 frames.
slots.soundRecipe: Peak of the track, then beginning to fall (inferred from loudness).

copySlot.purpose: The outcome word, then its object

slots.visualRecipe: Light ground; one empty frame; a centred sign-off line; then the address alone, small (about 0.05 frame height), centred. Final frame holds; no fade.
slots.motionRecipe: Words every 2 frames; hard replacement by the address after about 1.1 s; static to the end.
slots.soundRecipe: Track winds down to about a quarter of its level (inferred from loudness).

copySlot.purpose: Invitation ending on the brand name, then the address

rhythm.cutGrid: No beat grid (tempo not measured). 38 cuts in 46 s, median hold 0.97 s (0.23-3.07 s). Hook: five picture changes in 1.27 s. Type shots 0.7-1.3 s, one line each; interface steps 1.6-3.1 s with motion inside. Every change is a hard cut; four start with one bare-ground frame. Words inside a line every 2 frames. In the second half, put cuts on transients where you can (source film: 6 of 16 vs 18% chance); in the interface walkthrough cut on the cursor press instead.

style: Two flat grounds (a warm cream and a warm near-black) alternating on hard cuts; one soft accent; one sentence-case grotesk at line size, hero words at 0.2-0.5 frame height; literal small graphics for each claim; real interface alternating with type shots; calm, large margins.

keep: Slot order: statement, turn to the viewer, mark, promise, first product screen, three capabilities each with a graphic pun then real interface, payoff, sign-off
Hard cuts only; ground flips from one flat ground to the other; one-frame bare-ground breath before key elements
One line per shot, words every 2 frames in final layout, 3-4 frame rise
A literal visual for each claim instead of a generic one
Interface walkthroughs cut on the click, scroll inside steps, captions held still through punch-ins
Eye parked where the next element will appear (held word, held caption, opened gap)
Visual reward held until after the last capability; end on a small, still address with no fade
mustChange: All branding: name, mark, wordmark, address and the disc-to-wordmark shapes
Accent colour, both grounds' exact values and the typeface
All graphics, including symbols, chips, flags, charts, photographs and portraits
All copy and every number, which must be true for the new product
Interface: the new product's own real screens, captured, never a mock
